en: Psalms 89
A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite.

zh: 以斯拉人以探的訓誨詩。

p.src: 1  I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

en: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
u.src: 1  I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

p.src: 2  I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

en: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
u.src: 2  I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

p.src: 3  “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

en: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
u.src: 3  “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

p.src: 4  ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

en: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
u.src: 4  ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

p.src: 5  The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

en: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
u.src: 5  The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

p.src: 6  For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

en: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,
u.src: 6  For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

p.src: 7  a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

en: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
u.src: 7  a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

p.src: 8  LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

en: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.
u.src: 8  LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

en:
89:8 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
89:8 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 9  You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

en: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
u.src: 9  You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

p.src: 10  You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

en: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
u.src: 10  You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

p.src: 11  The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

en: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
u.src: 11  The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

p.src: 12  You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

en: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
u.src: 12  You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

p.src: 13  You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

en: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
u.src: 13  You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

p.src: 14  Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
u.src: 14  Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

p.src: 15  Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

en: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
u.src: 15  Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

p.src: 16  In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

en: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
u.src: 16  In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

p.src: 17  For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

en: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
u.src: 17  For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

p.src: 18  For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

en: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
u.src: 18  For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

p.src: 19  Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

en: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
u.src: 19  Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

p.src: 20  I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

en: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
u.src: 20  I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

p.src: 21  with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

en: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
u.src: 21  with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

p.src: 22  No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

en: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
u.src: 22  No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

p.src: 23  I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

en: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
u.src: 23  I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

p.src: 24  But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

en: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
u.src: 24  But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

p.src: 25  I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
u.src: 25  I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

p.src: 26  He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

en: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
u.src: 26  He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

p.src: 27  I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
u.src: 27  I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

p.src: 28  I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

en: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
u.src: 28  I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

p.src: 29  I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

en: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
u.src: 29  I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

p.src: 30  If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

en: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
u.src: 30  If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

p.src: 31  if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

en: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
u.src: 31  if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

p.src: 32  then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

en: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
u.src: 32  then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

p.src: 33  But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

en: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
u.src: 33  But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

p.src: 34  I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

en: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
u.src: 34  I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

p.src: 35  Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

en: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
u.src: 35  Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

p.src: 36  His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

en: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
u.src: 36  His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

p.src: 37  It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

en: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
u.src: 37  It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

p.src: 38  But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

en: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
u.src: 38  But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

p.src: 39  You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

en: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
u.src: 39  You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

p.src: 40  You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

en: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
u.src: 40  You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

p.src: 41  All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

en: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
u.src: 41  All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

p.src: 42  You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

en: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
u.src: 42  You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

p.src: 43  Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

en: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
u.src: 43  Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

p.src: 44  You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

en: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
u.src: 44  You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

p.src: 45  You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

en: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
u.src: 45  You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

p.src: 46  How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

en: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
u.src: 46  How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

p.src: 47  Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

en: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
u.src: 47  Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

p.src: 48  What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

en: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
u.src: 48  What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

en: 89:48 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 49  Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

en: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
u.src: 49  Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

p.src: 50  Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
u.src: 50  Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

p.src: 51  With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

en: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
u.src: 51  With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

p.src: 52  Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

en: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
u.src: 52  Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
